title: Hero band: nav pills and a centred wordmark, a two-line serif headline, a deck, an ink and a ghost button, a square colour field with one hand-drawn picture, an oat strip of three labels
use: The first screen of a product or lab site; subject picks the picture, field its colour, tile its size.

field.note: the colour field behind the picture

subject.note: which picture: 0 hand-graph, 1 seedling, 2 book, 3 magnifier, 4 spark-hands, 5 path, 6 candles, 7 compass

tile.note: size of the colour field (1 = 560 units)

deck.default: 从研究、回测到实盘监控，一个工作台留下每一步的证据。

meta.default: 示例站点 · 文案为占位

relations: Nav 28 units from the top: pills 34 high (15 sans, paper fill, 1 unit hairline), wordmark centred in bold tracked sans 24; the headline is serif 78 at weight 400, two lines at 94 units, the deck 20 sans in 600 units, then an ink 10 unit button 52 high and a flat grey one.

The colour field is 560 units square (times tile) right of the copy, inset 80 from the right edge, the picture 82% of it; the oat strip is the bottom 100 units with a clay dot and a 16 sans label per third.
decoration: The colour field, the picture and its crayon line filter, the clay dots; the text slots are the only measured content.

provenance.corpus: product-site kit (examples/brand-band-site-kit): our own original one-page site in Chinese in the brand-band grammar; all copy is a placeholder
provenance.experiment: styles/brand-band/style.json provenance (public pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped); the pictures are our own code-drawn illustrations
provenance.method: The measured home hero re-set on 1600 x 900: pill nav, serif statement, a square colour field with a small drawing; sizes scaled from the measured 47.8 px statement and 13 px pills.
measured: Nav 84 px high on the ivory ground with 13 px pills (radius full, #F5F4ED, 1 px #E8E6DC), a centred wordmark; statement serif 47.8 / 59.7; ink button 17 px, padding 12 x 24, radius 10.
Template: eight pictures and five fields pass the static check; the default passes --browser.
